tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List available root domains (e.g. sitey.my, sitey.one) that you can create subdomains under. Call this first to know which domains are available.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check if a specific subdomain name is available for registration under a given domain. Returns true if the name is free to claim.

tools.name: create_subdomain
tools.description: Create a new DNS record for a subdomain. Supports A records (IP address), CNAME records (hostname) and REDIRECT records (an https:// URL — visitors to the name are sent there with a 301). Example: create demo.sitey.my pointing to 1.2.3.4. No account, API key or signup is needed. The target does not

tools.name: list_subdomains
tools.description: List all subdomains you own. Returns subdomain name, domain, record type, value, and creation date. A REDIRECT record also carries hits: how many visits it has answered in total, how many this calendar month, and when the last one was. Filtered by your API key, or by the owner_token you pass, or — f

tools.name: renew_subdomain
tools.description: Extend a subdomain you own before it expires. Subdomains are lent for a period, not given: agent-created records last one month and user records three. Nothing emails an agent, so read expires_at from list_subdomains and call this before that date. One call resets the clock from today. Renewal only

tools.name: extend_subdomain
tools.description: Paying for a year is switched off on this server, so this always answers PAYMENT_DISABLED. Use renew_subdomain, which is free and adds a month.

tools.name: update_subdomain
tools.description: Update the DNS record value of a subdomain you own. For example, change the IP address that demo.sitey.my points to. The new target does not have to be serving yet; the result carries reachable:false when nothing answered, and the record is moved either way.

tools.name: delete_subdomain
tools.description: Permanently delete a subdomain DNS record you own. The subdomain will stop resolving immediately.

tools.name: create_txt_record
tools.description: Create or update a TXT record for domain verification. Used for services like Vercel (_vercel) and Netlify that require DNS-based ownership proof. The record is placed at the root domain under the prefix you give (e.g. _vercel.sitey.my), alongside the other owners' values — that is the name Vercel r

tools.name: delete_txt_record
tools.description: Delete a TXT verification record from a subdomain you own.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_txt_record" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: renew_subdomain · Private data: create_subdomain, list_subdomains, renew_subdomain, update_subdomain, delete_subdomain, create_txt_record, delete_txt_record · Public sink: create_subdomain, create_txt_record · Destructive: create_subdomain, delete_subdomain, delete_txt_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: renew_subdomain · Private data: create_subdomain, list_subdomains, renew_subdomain, update_subdomain, delete_subdomain, create_txt_record, delete_txt_record · Public sink: create_subdomain, create_txt_record · Destructive: create_subdomain, delete_subdomain, delete_txt_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_subdomain" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
